Section(s): The model for the standard cultivation conditions in STRs suggests that sucrose levels can be reduced without affecting biomass formation and volumetric biomass yield; FIGURE 2

Text and equations in reading order:
    The model assumes an irreversible progression in which active cells (active DM) are converted into dead cells (dead DM) (Jacob et al., 2020) (Eq. 2).
(2) V\frac{dX_{a}}{dt}+X_{a}\frac{dV}{dt}=\mu X_{a}V-k_{d}X_{a}V    [code: ODE, computes X_{a}, code proposes balance]
    where $\mu$ [$\mathrm{h}^{-1}$] is the specific growth rate, $k_{d}$ [$\mathrm{h}^{-1}$] is the death rate constant of active DM, and $V$ [L] is the volume of the cultivation medium. Based on the volumetric change of the cultivation medium, we calculated the feed rate $F_{t}$ [$\mathrm{L}\ \mathrm{h}^{-1}$] for each time point $t$ (Jiménez-Hornero et al., 2009a) (Eq. 3).

(3) \frac{dV}{dt}=F_{t}    [code: ODE, computes V, code proposes balance]
    The dependency of the specific growth rate (biomass formation) of active DM ($\mu$) on sucrose (S), ammonium (A) and nitrate (N) concentrations can be expressed as a Monod kinetic (Eq. 4).
    The sucrose, ammonium, nitrate and phosphate concentrations during BY-2 cultivation were modeled in Equations 5–8.
(5) V\frac{dS}{dt}+S\frac{dV}{dt}=F_{t}S_{f}-\mu_{S}\left(\frac{S}{S+K_{S}}\frac{K_{IS}}{S+K_{IS}}\right)X_{a}V    [code: ODE, computes S, code proposes balance]
(6) V\frac{dN}{dt}+N\frac{dV}{dt}=F_{t}N_{f}-\mu_{N}\left(\frac{N}{N+K_{N}}\frac{K_{IN}}{N+K_{IN}}\right)X_{a}V    [code: ODE, computes N, code proposes balance]
(7) V\frac{d\boldsymbol{A}}{d t}+\boldsymbol{A}\frac{d\boldsymbol{V}}{d t}=\boldsymbol{F}_{t}\boldsymbol{A}_{f}-\mu_{A}\left(\frac{\boldsymbol{A}}{\boldsymbol{A}+\boldsymbol{K}_{A}}\frac{\boldsymbol{K}_{I A}}{\boldsymbol{A}+\boldsymbol{K}_{I A}}\right)\boldsymbol{X}_{a}\boldsymbol{V}    [code: ODE, computes A, code proposes balance]
(8) V\frac{dP}{dt}+P\frac{dV}{dt}=F_{t}P_{f}-\mu_{P}P\quad V    [code: ODE, computes P, code proposes balance]

Symbols:
  V: V is the volume of the cultivation medium. [L] (computed)
  X_{a}: X_a is the viable (active) cell dry mass. [g L^{-1}] (computed)
  \mu: μ is the specific growth rate. [h^{-1}] (computed)
  k_{d}: k_d is the death rate constant of active DM. [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  F_{t}: F_t is the feed rate. [L h^{-1}] (variable)
  S: S is the sucrose concentration. [g L^{-1}] (computed)
  S_{f}: S_f is the feed medium concentration of sucrose. [g L^{-1}] (variable)
  \mu_{S}: μ_S denotes the specific uptake rate for sucrose. [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{S}: K_S is the sucrose saturation constant. [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{IS}: K_IS is the sucrose inhibition constant. [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  N: Nitrate concentration [g L^{-1}] (computed)
  N_{f}: Feed nitrate concentration [g L^{-1}] (variable)
  \mu_{N}: Nitrate consumption rate [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{N}: Nitrate saturation constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{IN}: Nitrate inhibition constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  A: Concentration of nutrients (sucrose, ammonium, nitrate, phosphate) in the reactor [g L^{-1}] (computed)
  A_{f}: Feed medium concentration of ammonium [g L^{-1}] (variable)
  \mu_{A}: Ammonium consumption rate [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{A}: Ammonium saturation constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{IA}: Ammonium inhibition constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  P: phosphate concentration (computed)
  P_{f}: feed medium concentration of phosphate (variable)
  \mu_{P}: Phosphate consumption rate [h^{-1}] (parameter)

  - The model assumes an irreversible progression in which active cells (active DM) are converted into dead cells (dead DM).
